en.topic_title: Hong Kong lyricist Peter Lai dies at 76

zh.topic_title: Hong Kong lyricist Peter Lai dies at 76

en.topic_title: Hong Kong lyricist Peter Lai dies at 76
en.topic_summary:
Renowned Hong Kong lyricist Peter Lai, who spearheaded the city’s golden era of Cantonese pop music, has died aged 76, his family and friends said Thursday.



Peter Lai. Photo: Supplied.



Lai was hospitalised after suffering a stroke this year and passed away on Wednesday morning, his son and a long-time friend said at a press conference.



Nicknamed “The Lyrical Maverick”, he wrote the words to hits including “Monica” in 1984, performed by superstar Leslie Cheu
